eligibility_reason: Original study training and evaluating a YOLOv11-based detector on NEU-DET and GC10-DET.

F01.evidence: The NEU-DET dataset is an open-source metal surface defect dataset published by Northeastern University, containing 1800 images of hot-rolled steel strip surfaces.

F02.evidence: It was randomly divided into a training set (1440 images), validation set (180 images), and test set (180 images) in an 8:1:1 ratio.

F05.evidence: To ensure fairness and comparability of experimental results, no pre-trained weights were used.

F11.evidence: During the training phase, only Mosaic data augmentation was employed with a batch size set to 32.
